title: MIRROR board profile
description: One known combination of MIRROR board and factory kernel. A Silvering image is built for exactly one profile, because the board keeps its own signed kernel and the image's kernel modules must match it.

id.description: Platform and the kernel's build hash, as in its release string.

evidence.description: observed: seen on a unit this project works with. reported: read from an owner's report and not seen here.

labels.description: Printed board revisions this combination was seen on. Software cannot read the printed label.

match.description: What a running Android must report for this profile to apply.

mirrorOsVersions.description: Factory MirrorOS versions seen with this kernel.

install.description: How Silvering is installed on this combination. null until an image has been built and accepted on such a unit; the installer offers no flash for a profile without it.
